entities.name: María del Risco
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Cecilia del Risco is a Peruvian former volleyball player who competed in the 1976 Summer Olympics, the 1980 Summer Olympics, and the 1984 Summer Olympics. She was a member of the Peruvian team that won second place in the 1982 FIVB World Championship in Peru.
